description: This file defines the RecurringDepositAccount class, which extends SavingsAccount, representing a recurring deposit account in the Fineract financial platform. It includes methods for account creation, activation, closure, interest posting, maturity calculation, and schedule management, incorporating domain-specific logic for deposit installments, interest calculations, and account states.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccount
classes.description: Represents a recurring deposit account with methods for account lifecycle management, interest calculations, schedule handling, and domain validations.

methods.name: createNewApplicationForSubmittal
methods.description: Creates a new recurring deposit account application in pending approval status.

methods.name: createNewActivatedAccount
methods.description: Creates and activates a new recurring deposit account.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a savings account, with additional validation for expected deposit date.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Handles deposit transactions with validation against maturity, deposit start date, and account status.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the account, performing validation for closure date, maturity, and transaction history.

methods.name: reInvest
methods.description: Reinvests the account upon closure, creating a new account with deposit details.

methods.name: validateDomainRules
methods.description: Validates domain-specific rules such as deposit period constraints.

methods.name: calculateMaturityDate
methods.description: Calculates the account's maturity date based on deposit period and start date.

methods.name: calculatePreMatureAmount
methods.description: Calculates the amount payable if the deposit is prematurely closed before maturity.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts interest for the account up to a specified date, including handling interest transfer and reversal.

methods.name: postPreMatureInterest
methods.description: Posts interest on account closure if closed before maturity.

methods.name: maturityAmount
methods.description: Returns the calculated maturity amount of the deposit.

methods.name: depositStartDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the deposit starts (activation or expected first deposit date).
